title: Emotional Support with Conversational AI: Talking to Machines About Life
reasoning: The paper includes a significant qualitative analysis of how users interact with LLMs for spiritual, religious, and moral guidance. It examines discourse from specific religious subreddits (r/islam, r/hinduism, r/Christianity, r/Buddhism) and contains dedicated sections on AI as a 'Moral Reasoning Partner' and concerns regarding 'AI as Spiritual or Moral Authority'.
